# AgentSecure Community

AgentSecure is a local-first security runtime for AI coding agents. Real secrets
stay in a local vault and agents use bounded placeholders and MCP tools.

## Agent setup

- [Claude Code setup](https://github.com/ShellFrameAI/agentsecure-community/blob/main/docs/claude-code-setup.md)
- [Project overview and CLI reference](https://github.com/ShellFrameAI/agentsecure-community/blob/main/README.md)
- [Security model](https://github.com/ShellFrameAI/agentsecure-community/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
- [Contribution guide](https://github.com/ShellFrameAI/agentsecure-community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)

For Claude Code, inspect the repository's existing Python toolchain before
installation, then run `agentsecure start --client claude`. This creates or
updates persistent AgentSecure guidance in `CLAUDE.md` without replacing
existing project instructions.
